_comment: eye: THE WATCHING EYE over the tower -- a low-poly unit-sphere eyeball (16 segments about the gaze axis, radius exactly 1.0, so WatchingEyeProfile.radius_metres is literally metres) with an iris cap and a pupil cap on radii 1.015 and 1.028, rim radii 0.580 and 0.290. THE GAZE AXIS IS glTF +Z. Three nodes, one surface each, three materials textured from tower/textures/eye.ase (eye_sclera_albedo, eye_iris_albedo + eye_iris_emissive, eye_pupil_albedo), each part unwrapped as a disc seen down the gaze axis. No rig, no animation, NO COLLISION. The cap radii are a depth budget: eye_build.py measures every clearance by ray and refuses to install under MIN_CLEARANCE=0.009. Node names are addressed by the scene, the looks and the tests. 368 tris = 256 sclera + 64 iris + 48 pupil.
